name: Colorado Springs
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Colorado Springs for 2026, and here is what he found: 24 family events, 9 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Santa's Wonderland at Bass Pro Shops) through January 31 (Skate in the Park at Acacia Park), with The Christmas Stroll (November 28), Festival of Lights Parade (December 5) and Electric Safari (from December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Colorado Springs

  • 24 Christmas events for kids in Colorado Springs, after moving 5 listings to Fountain, Manitou Springs, Woodland Park and Monument
  • 9 free events, including Old Colorado City Christkindlmarket, Festival of Lights Parade, Jingle Jam and Photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus at the Fine Arts Center
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus at the Fine Arts Center, Santa's Wonderland at Bass Pro Shops and Holiday on the Hill
  • Lights and skating: Electric Safari at Cheyenne Mountain Zoo and Skate in the Park at Acacia Park
  • Shows: A Colorado Nutcracker at Pikes Peak Center (December 22 and 23) and the Classic Broadmoor Holiday Show
  • Season: November 26, 2026 to January 31, 2027

Heading out of the city? Colorado Springs families also use our guides to Christmas activities for kids in Manitou Springs, Fountain, Monument, Woodland Park and Pueblo.
